question: The myenteric or Auerbach plexus of the digestive tract:

options.opa: It contains postganglionic neurons of the sympathetic nervous system.
options.opb: It is located between the layers of longitudinal and circular smooth muscle.
options.opc: Innervates the secretory glands of the intestinal mucosa.
options.opd: It is located between the circular smooth muscle layer and the submucosa.
